scope: Only the five newly authorized acceptance-decision files; no controller/parent/old artifact writes, no GPU, no renderer, no other agents.

functional_achievement.evidence: 65 CPU tests cover full finite decision, actual t0 gate and mandatory delegated hand camera binding for every method window; real acceptance roots have not been evaluated.

correctness_reliability.evidence: Independent raw geometry/contact/motion calculations, exact native pairing, no epsilon, actualwait and SHA closure gates; synthetic CPU evidence only.

architecture.evidence: Standalone stdlib+NumPy evidence binder and independent geometry/contact/motion decision. Source-frozen existing native/camera and audit_hand_views oracles prove render/pixel/frustum properties; no second hand frustum checker, no producer changes.

function_API.evidence: Strict preregistered execution and direct run_step audit receipt contract; a different future supervisor schema must be reviewed before use, never inferred safe.

style_maintainability.evidence: Single authorized module with explicit I/O ledger, bounded raw calculations, pure decision function and explicit failure classes.

performance.evidence: Full512-window raw I/O not benchmarked; chunk loading and complete hash rereads can take substantial CPU/I/O time. No latency or memory guarantee claimed.

non_blocking_boundaries: Complete real acceptance orchestration/receipts/512-window I/O has not run. CPU fixtures do not establish physics or experimental acceptance.

Three-boundary native/FIFO/camera identity is delegated to the two pre-existing source-frozen raw auditors; this checker independently recomputes geometry/contact/motion and validates their raw bindings, summaries, source and actual subprocess waits.
Hashes and timestamps detect inconsistency/change within this trusted local evidence workflow; they do not attest truthful sensors or defend against wholesale fabrication of all evidence.
minimum_required_repair: None identified for current registered finite checker; freeze final source and satisfy the documented input/actualwait contract before real use.

resolved_findings.issue: Float32 accumulation of128 raw float32 joint ranges could round a just-below .001 mean above the floor.
resolved_findings.resolution: Keep native per-window float32 ranges; aggregate their128 values in float64, matching the parent JSON-derived numeric definition.

Require argv,pid,actual_exit0,started_utc,closed_utc,tag,log_sha256; one unambiguous match for each audit.

api.hand_audit_wait_contract: Hand auditor script and ROOT argv must be absolute paths, output tag exactly {id}_hands; require one actual run_step wait receipt with integer actual_exit0,pid,timestamps,log SHA. Relative dev06 auditor argv is insufficient for formal fresh acceptance; do not reuse90frame dev receipts.

Missing binding in any of8bank/mode records yields INCOMPLETE_NOT_ACCEPTED; it cannot produce candidate adoption. Results include perjob group/handPNG/totalPNG and all_hand_camera_bindings_checked. All filenames/CLI otherwise unchanged.
